title: 美国AI放缓：芯片订单不降反扩散，供给才是硬瓶颈？
speaker: Hwasong Kwan

segments.en: Maybe this is not, you know, if AI labs in the US slowdown, it's not going to derail the growth picture for, of course, North Asia.
segments.zh: 也许这并不是说，如果美国AI实验室放缓，就会破坏北亚的增长前景。

segments.en: The biggest picture is that, you know, the chip is in short supply. So think about AI chips and HEPM, and advanced packaging capacity all remain in short supply.
segments.zh: 最大的图景是，芯片供应短缺。想想AI芯片、高带宽内存和先进封装产能，都仍然供不应求。

segments.en: So in the near-term, you know, the production in the factory would be constrained more by supply, rather than demand.
segments.zh: 所以短期内，工厂的生产更多受限于供给，而不是需求。

segments.en: And what I think is that even if, you know, AI developers slowdown their AI development, but it actually wouldn't lead to a substantial reduction in, you know, chip demand, because now demand for AI, or demand for AI chips is broadening to inferences from training.
segments.zh: 我认为，即使AI开发者放缓AI开发，实际上也不会导致芯片需求大幅减少，因为现在AI需求，或者说AI芯片需求，正从训练扩展到推理。

segments.en: And at the same time, think about that AI investment, like data center, has a multi-year lead time. So even if AI developed, AI companies, like open AI would pace, you know, pace AI development, it would lead to a reduction in AI investment, new investment at the same, you know, in the near-term, not the current investment.
segments.zh: 同时，想想AI配置，比如数据中心，有数年的前置时间。所以即使AI公司，比如OpenAI，放缓AI开发，也会导致AI新配置减少，是在短期内，而不是当前配置。
